nodes.label: k6 Cloud Runs reading conventions
nodes.rationale: --summary-export works on k6 cloud run unchanged; BASE_URL and K6_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID must always be read fresh from terraform output -json (never -raw, never cached in .env) because each project's k6 project id changes on every /env up rebuild since 2026-09-14.

nodes.label: Reading a UI-started k6 run from the Cloud API
nodes.rationale: A UI-started run has no local summary file; result_status is a string (not the inverted breach boolean), there is no error-rate field so failures_count/requests_count must be divided by hand, and an archived-but-never-run test returns metrics_summary:null.

nodes.label: Per-project results.md columns and completeness check
nodes.rationale: ecs-rds-postgres-pool's columns (pool wait p95, waiting peak, DBLoadCPU/vCPU, connections, pool size, credit balance, posts rows) never mix with ecs-dynamodb-rps's (throttles, RCU/WCU); field indices for the completeness awk check must be re-derived per project rather than assumed, since the same column number means a different column in each table.
